A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 28-page LLM DNA/RepTrace study, including Appendices A–G. Full-text comparison and page rendering support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments across 305 LLMs, including relationship detection, model routing, fine-tuning effects, and supplementary analyses in Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results, including the relationship-detection and routing outcomes in Tables 1–2 and the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same RepTrace procedure: generate responses, encode and concatenate their embeddings, and apply Gaussian random projection.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six extraction benchmarks, EmbedLLM routing data, OpenMathInstruct-2 fine-tuning data, 305-model collection, and random-input and same-tokenizer scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout. Relationship detection retains Random, Greedy, and PhyloLM + SVM; routing retains Random, Single Best, and EmbedLLM.

E3.justification: Sections 5 and Appendix B retain identical protocols, including 600 extraction prompts, 83 correlated and 83 sampled independent pairs, the 8:2 split, evaluation metrics, and model configurations.

E4.justification: Sections 5.4–5.7 and Appendix C retain the same dataset-stability, random-input, chat-template, fine-tuning, embedding-model, dimensionality, model-size, same-tokenizer, and false-positive analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report five-seed means and standard deviations, the same error-bar conventions, Mantel tests, and model-size correlation and significance analyses.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative observations are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains DNA (BGE) AUC of 0.992 ± 0.023, and Table 2 retains DNA routing accuracy of 0.672 ± 0.008.

T1.justification: The bi-Lipschitz DNA definition, existence theorem, random-projection corollary, concentration lemma, and all definitions and proofs in Appendix A are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about DNA properties, training-free extraction, relationship detection, and reconstruction of LLM evolutionary trees.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability discussions are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning DNA subsequences, adaptive attacks, and data bias or contamination.

D1.justification: The Reproducibility Statement and Appendices B and F retain identical hyperparameters, hardware information, model and license details, and code, demo, and package access information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and cited works are identical. Bibliography entries shifting between pages are retained references, not additions or removals.

P1.justification: v3 adds a sentence acknowledging Zhaomin Wu's support through an NRF Postdoctoral Award and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All remaining wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added acknowledgment reflows the references across pages 11–13. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding attribution on page 11, updates the version/date stamp, and consequently reflows the bibliography. The scientific text, evidence, proofs, reproducibility information, and limitations are unchanged, including all appendices. These administrative edits do not produce a meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
